panels.title: Độ trễ xử lý (Latency) theo thời gian thực

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(alert_time AS TIMESTAMP) as time, latency_ms FROM `project-7942816b-eab8-4949-8b8.fraud_features.realtime_fraud_logs` WHERE alert_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY alert_time DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Biến động Số lượng Giao dịch (Mỗi Batch)

targets.rawSql: SELECT processing_time as time, total_transactions_in_batch FROM `project-7942816b-eab8-4949-8b8.fraud_features.overall_summary` ORDER BY processing_time DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Tổng số Giao dịch Hệ thống

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as safe_count FROM `project-7942816b-eab8-4949-8b8.fraud_features.realtime_fraud_logs` WHERE is_fraud_predicted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) as fraud_count FROM `project-7942816b-eab8-4949-8b8.fraud_features.realtime_fraud_logs` WHERE is_fraud_predicted = 1

panels.title: 📊 TỈ LỆ GIAO DỊCH AN TOÀN / GIAN LẬN

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN is_fraud_predicted = 1 THEN 'Gian lận (Fraud)' ELSE 'An toàn (Safe)' END as status, COUNT(*) as quantity FROM `project-7942816b-eab8-4949-8b8.fraud_features.realtime_fraud_logs` GROUP BY is_fraud_predicted

panels.title: 🔴 REAL-TIME FRAUD LOGS (CLICK SỐ THẺ ĐỂ PHÂN TÍCH AI)

targets.rawSql: SELECT alert_time, CAST(cc_num AS STRING) as card_number, amt, hour, age, distance_km, velocity_1d_count, velocity_1d_amt_sum, category FROM `project-7942816b-eab8-4949-8b8.fraud_features.realtime_fraud_logs` WHERE is_fraud_predicted = 1 ORDER BY alert_time DESC LIMIT 30

value.title: 🚨 Phân tích chuyên sâu dòng này

panels.title: Thống kê Tổng Giao Dịch theo Danh Mục

targets.rawSql: SELECT category, SUM(total_transactions) as total_tx FROM `project-7942816b-eab8-4949-8b8.fraud_features.category_summary` GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_tx DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Phân bổ Giao dịch theo Giới tính

targets.rawSql: SELECT gender, SUM(total_transactions) as total_tx FROM `project-7942816b-eab8-4949-8b8.fraud_features.gender_summary` GROUP BY gender

panels.title: Top 15 Bang (State) Giao Dịch Nhiều Nhất

targets.rawSql: SELECT state, SUM(total_transactions) as total_tx FROM `project-7942816b-eab8-4949-8b8.fraud_features.geo_summary` GROUP BY state ORDER BY total_tx DESC LIMIT 15
